staging.selection_order: listed optimizer profile order, excluding baseline
staging.selection: first profile with developmental target-row sufficiency at least 0.23488134473378872; if none, profile with maximum developmental target-row sufficiency, tie broken by listed order

decisions.baseline_apparatus: baseline developmental installed attack excess must be at least 0.23488134473378872 within each size; failure blocks only that size because the optimizer harness did not reproduce learnability at N=64
decisions.table_carries_behavior: lower endpoint of five-seed 95% Student-t interval for target-row sufficiency exceeds 0.15
decisions.table_is_necessary: lower endpoint for target-row restoration effect exceeds 0.15
decisions.deletion_is_specific: lower endpoint for target-zero localization specificity against benign/random controls exceeds 0.15
decisions.outside_table_copy: lower endpoint for ASR after whole-table restoration minus clean ASR exceeds 0.15
decisions.row_transplant_deletes: lower endpoint for deleting the transplanted target rows exceeds 0.15
decisions.no_compound_gate: all scientific estimands are reported separately; profile selection affects which independent-seed condition is replicated, not whether its outcomes are reported

verification: full optimizer and evaluation replay from sealed clean checkpoints; output manifest; raw prediction disagreement and registered-decision reproduction

budget.scale_justification: seven prospectively fixed developmental profiles span the S1 optimizer and the 1e-3 to 1e-1 range that made direct row writes learnable; five fresh training seeds at both sizes test the independently selected profile; 1024 prompts preserve the effect resolution while seeds remain the replication unit
